videos.script: A model cannot run your code. It can only ask. {{roundtrip}} In this lesson you watch one request go out, a tool call come back, and a result go in, block by block. And you watch a small model read a price in cents as dollars. {{schema}} Then the checks. A schema says what a call must look like. The shop's own code says what is true about the orders. {{layers}} A call that breaks either comes back with the reason, so the model can correct it. {{repair}} The same idea turns an email into a ticket. A reply that does not fit gets one more try, then a person, and a schema the server enforces keeps the shape but not the meaning. {{retry}} And a call that runs twice. A return opened twice is a real mistake, and a key from the host stops it. Every reply in this lesson is from the model on your computer; every check and every error is your code.
